title: Thirteen Minutes in Munich
dek: A quiet carpenter spent more than thirty nights alone inside a Munich beer hall, hollowing out the pillar behind Hitler's lectern. On 8 November 1939 his bomb went off just as he had planned. Hitler had walked out thirteen minutes earlier.

title: The Spy Moscow Disowned
dek: Richard Sorge warned Stalin that Germany would invade, and was ignored. Then he told Moscow that Japan would not attack, and was believed. On 7 November 1944 Japan hanged him, and for twenty years the country he served would not admit he had been its spy.

title: The Last Stand of Taffy 3
dek: On 25 October 1944, six little carriers and seven escorts woke up to find the biggest battleship ever built bearing down on them. This is what they did next.
